# VideoGator - AI Video Generation Aggregator
# https://videogator.vercel.app
# Last updated: 2026-02-25

## What is VideoGator?
VideoGator is a free platform for comparing AI video generation tools and generating videos locally using your own GPU. It includes a service directory, prompt library, cinematography-focused prompt builder, comparison engine, and guides.

## Services Compared (17 total)

### Commercial APIs
- Runway Gen-3 Alpha Turbo: Text/image-to-video, up to 4K, 10s clips, API available. From $0.05/sec.
- Kling AI 1.6: Text/image-to-video, up to 1080p, 10s clips, API available. From $0.014/sec.
- Pika 2.0: Text/image-to-video, up to 1080p, 4s clips, API available. From $0.035/sec.
- Luma Dream Machine 1.5: Text/image-to-video, up to 1080p, 5s clips, API available. Free tier + paid.
- MiniMax Video-01: Text/image-to-video, up to 1080p, 6s clips, API available. From $0.03/sec.
- OpenAI Sora Turbo: Text/image-to-video, up to 1080p, 20s clips. $200/mo ChatGPT Pro.
- Google Veo 2: Text/image-to-video, up to 4K, 8s clips. Vertex AI access.
- Seedance 1.0 (ByteDance): Text/image-to-video, up to 1080p, multi-shot. Credits-based.
- HeyGen: Avatar-based video, lip sync, up to 1080p. From $29/mo.

### Open Source (Self-Hostable, Free)
- Wan 2.1 (Alibaba): Text/image-to-video, up to 720p, 5s clips. Requires 8-24GB VRAM.
- HunyuanVideo (Tencent): Text-to-video, up to 720p, 5s clips. Requires 16-24GB VRAM.
- CogVideoX-5B (Tsinghua): Text/image-to-video, up to 720p, 6s clips. Requires 16GB VRAM.
- LTX-Video 2 (Lightricks): Text/image-to-video, up to 4K, 20s clips. Requires 16GB VRAM.
- Mochi 1 (Genmo): Text-to-video, up to 848x480, 5s clips. Requires 20-24GB VRAM.

### Infrastructure
- RunPod: GPU cloud rentals from $0.39/hr (RTX 4090).
- Replicate: Pay-per-prediction API for open source models.
- fal.ai: Serverless GPU inference, pay per second.

## Prompt Library (24 curated prompts)
Categories: Cinematic, Anime, Documentary, Product, Abstract, Retro, Nature, Sci-Fi

## Cinematic Prompt Builder
Interactive tool teaching cinematography through AI video generation:
- 8 emotion arcs (tense, longing, awe, melancholy, unease, joy, power, mystery)
- 8 scene archetypes with style variations
- 70+ cinematography tags (camera movement, angles, lenses, lighting, color grading, atmosphere)
- Character consistency strategies for open-source models
- 10 preset recipes with film references
- Educational "Film School" panel explaining why technique combinations work

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4
- Auth: Supabase
- Video Generation: Local GPU via FastAPI server (supports HunyuanVideo, Mochi, CogVideoX, ModelScope, SVD)
- Deployment: Vercel
